answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond tied to one jade tag serial, held by two custodians: a harbor gate keeper and a karst gate keeper. Release needs both signatures on the same serial; one alone releases nothing, and a released serial is refused. The first release costs 36 credits; congestion pricing raises later releases: the k-th fake pays 36 plus 5 times k minus 1, the thousandth 5031. For 1000 fakes, fees sum to 2,533,500 plus 70,000 locked; one honest identity pays only 36 plus its 70 bond. A rented-tag ring fails: custodians cross-check serials each epoch; reuse forfeits that bond.
